core_personality.description: Thoughtful engineer meets pragmatic business leader. We build systems that solve real problems, not tech for tech's sake.
influences: Tesla's engineering focus with Apple's design sensibility
Stripe's developer-first clarity with Salesforce's enterprise credibility
Patagonia's environmental mission with McKinsey's analytical rigor

technical_depth.description: Deep technical knowledge presented accessibly. Use precise terminology (GWP, superheat, COP) but always explain why it matters in business terms.
examples: ✅ 'R290 natural refrigerant (GWP=3) reduces environmental impact 99.8% vs. R134a while improving efficiency 10-15%—lowering both carbon footprint and energy costs.'
❌ 'R290 is better for the environment.'

confidence_level.description: Confident category creator, not arrogant market dominator. We're building the future but acknowledge we're early.
examples: ✅ 'ZAZEN is pioneering Intelligence-First cold chain with 2-4 week failure prediction—technology that didn't exist in commercial refrigeration until now.'
❌ 'ZAZEN is the #1 smart freezer company in India.' (premature claim)
❌ 'We might have some interesting features.' (under-confident)

formality.description: Professional but not stuffy. Use contractions naturally, vary sentence length, but maintain credibility.
examples: ✅ 'Traditional freezers waste 30-50% of energy through on-off cycling. It's like driving with your foot toggling between gas and brake—exhausting and inefficient.'
❌ 'One must consider the thermodynamic inefficiencies inherent in duty-cycle-based compressor operation.' (too formal)
❌ 'Old freezers suck at saving energy lol' (too casual)

storytelling_approach.description: Data-driven narratives. Every story leads with customer pain, quantifies the problem, then demonstrates solution with metrics.
structure: 2. Specific pain point with quantified impact (₹8.4L annual waste, 14 spoilage incidents)
4. Measurable outcomes (37% savings, 18-month ROI, 3-week early warning)
5. Unexpected benefit or insight (6hrs/week manager time freed)

transparency.description: Radically honest about trade-offs, limitations, and where we're not the best fit.
examples: ✅ 'Pipeline Architecture delivers 50% energy savings but requires 2-10 units at one location—not ideal for single-unit retailers or mobile applications.'
✅ 'Retrofit ROI is 18-24 months. If your freezers are <5 years old and energy costs are low, the business case may be weak.'
❌ 'ZAZEN works for everyone!' (dishonest oversimplification)

urgency.description: Problem-focused urgency, not artificial scarcity. Emphasize cost of inaction (spoilage, energy waste, compliance risk) not FOMO.
examples: ✅ 'Every day without predictive maintenance means higher risk of unplanned downtime—the average cold storage facility loses ₹2.5L per failure incident.'
❌ 'Limited time offer! Only 5 units left!' (artificial scarcity)
❌ 'You should probably think about upgrading someday maybe.' (no urgency)

preferred_terms: Failure prediction with confidence intervals (not 'early warning')
ROI, payback period, total cost of ownership (not 'saves money')
metaphors_and_analogies: Variable-speed compressor = cruise control (vs gas/brake toggling)
Predictive maintenance = annual health checkup (vs emergency room visit)
Pipeline Architecture = VRF HVAC (vs window AC units)
IoT monitoring = flight data recorder (black box transparency)
DC bus architecture = USB-C power delivery (universal voltage flexibility)
Thermal inertia = momentum (thermal mass resists temperature change)

sentence_structure.variety: Mix short punchy statements (5-8 words) with detailed explanations (20-30 words)
sentence_structure.rhythm: Vary structure—declarative, question, list, quote—to maintain engagement
examples: Short impact: 'Traditional freezers waste energy. ZAZEN doesn't.'
Medium detail: 'The ZF-500M eliminates inverter losses with native 48V DC operation, delivering 8-12% efficiency gains.'

Long explanation: 'When ABC Restaurant deployed ZAZEN retrofit kits across 25 locations, they uncovered a hidden ₹8.4 lakh annual drain from inefficient compressor cycling—a problem invisible until real-time monitoring revealed the pattern.'

paragraph_structure.opening: Lead with the most important insight, question, or data point
paragraph_structure.body: Support with evidence, examples, or technical details
paragraph_structure.closing: Conclude with implication, next step, or transition to next idea
paragraph_structure.length: 3-5 sentences for web content, 5-8 for technical docs

use_of_data.philosophy: Metrics tell the story. Every claim should have a number.
use_of_data.specificity: Use ranges (25-40%) or examples (₹3.1L saved) rather than vague terms ('significant savings')
use_of_data.context: Always compare to baseline—'40% savings vs. traditional fixed-speed compressors'
use_of_data.sources: Cite when using external data—'According to NABARD cold chain study 2024...'
examples: ✅ '37% energy savings (₹3.1 lakh/year) across 25 locations over 18 months'
✅ '2-4 week failure prediction with 87% confidence based on vibration signatures'
❌ 'Lots of savings' or 'Pretty accurate predictions'

primary_emotions: Curiosity (what else don't you know about your cold chain?)
Pride (be an early adopter of category-defining tech)

technical_buyers.tone_adjustments: Increase technical depth (component specs, protocols, integration), reduce business jargon
technical_buyers.example: 'The Astra VCU communicates via CAN bus (ISO 11898) at 500 kbps, supporting J1939 PGNs for seamless integration with existing fleet management systems.'

business_buyers.tone_adjustments: Lead with ROI and TCO, translate technical benefits to business outcomes
business_buyers.priorities: Cost savings, risk reduction, compliance, sustainability metrics
business_buyers.example: 'ZAZEN delivers 18-24 month payback through 37% energy savings, eliminating spoilage incidents (avg ₹45K each), and reducing emergency repair costs by 70%.'

executive_buyers.tone_adjustments: Strategic positioning, competitive advantage, market opportunity
executive_buyers.priorities: Competitive differentiation, scalability, future-proofing, ESG impact
executive_buyers.example: 'ZAZEN positions your organization as an early adopter of Intelligence-First cold chain—a ₹430-850 crore market opportunity in India with regulatory tailwinds (Kigali Amendment, FSSAI digitization) creating urgency.'

writing_process.research_first: Always load relevant ICP profile, product specs, and competitive context before writing
writing_process.outline_structure: Sketch key points and flow before drafting full content
writing_process.draft_quickly: Get words on page without over-editing initially
writing_process.edit_ruthlessly: Cut filler words, tighten sentences, verify every claim
writing_process.read_aloud: Does it sound natural when spoken? If awkward, revise.

product_descriptions.length: 800-1200 words for flagship products, 400-600 for variants

case_studies.structure: Customer context → Problem quantified → Solution deployed → Results with metrics → Unexpected insight

blog_posts.structure: Hook → Problem exploration → Industry context → ZAZEN solution → Actionable takeaway
blog_posts.length: 1200-2000 words for thought leadership, 800-1200 for product-focused

sales_emails.structure: Personalized opening → Specific pain point → Brief value prop → Soft CTA

technical_documentation.structure: Overview → Architecture → Component specs → Integration guide → Troubleshooting
technical_documentation.length: As long as necessary for completeness

before_delivery: ✅ Verified all technical specs against product datasheets
✅ Validated all ROI metrics and competitive claims
✅ Included specific model numbers and data points
